currentPage.title: What to Expect
currentPage.seoDescription: Here’s what you can expect when you attend Life.Church.
currentPage.seoKeywords: what to expect, what is Life.Church like, first time, visitor, LifeKids, Switch, LifeGroups, Missions, faq

0.title: What happens when I attend the first time?
0.content: At Life.Church, you’ll be welcomed into a friendly, casual environment by people who are excited to see you. And don’t worry—you won’t get lost. We’ll help you find your seat so you have the best experience. We can’t wait to see you!

00.title: What do I wear to a church service?
00.content: When you attend a physical Life.Church location, you’ll find that everyone has their style, from casual to professional. We believe that church isn’t about what you look like or wear; it’s about who you are on the inside. Come just as you are.

01.content:
We want to talk with you and support you. You can can talk with a pastor or caring volunteer who’d love to help you figure out your next step at church and in your relationship with Christ.

If you’re at a location, visit the Info Wall outside the Auditorium.

If you’re attending at Life.Church Online, you can always connect with us and send a question.
01.title: What if I have questions?

02.title: What about my kids?
02.content:
Your kids will love LifeKids! While you attend service, your kids ages birth-6th grade will experience age-specific lessons, activities, and small groups designed just for them.

Have a teenager? Learn more about Switch, our student ministry.

04.content: Life.Church started with a simple idea: What if there were a church where you could just come as you are? Wherever you are on your journey, there’s a place for you here.

02.content:
Each service to last one hour

Thought-provoking and engaging messages based on the Bible

Video teaching from Senior Pastor Craig Groeschel or a Life.Church pastor

High-energy worship music

Fun teaching for your kids

Over 130 services throughout the week at live.life.church, social media channels, and YouTube 

Real community with others around the world through live chat and prayer

Gather at Watch Parties in cities everywhere for you and your friends

Timely messages from Senior Pastor Craig Groeschel or a Life.Church pastor

High-energy worship music

0111.headingText: There’s a place for everyone at Life.Church.

0.content: Children from birth-6th grade learn who God is and understand who they are in LifeKids.
0.title: Kids Ministry

00.title: Student Ministry
00.content: Switch exists to lead 6th-12th grade students to become fully devoted followers of Christ.

0.title: LifeGroups
0.content: Find community where you can grow spiritually and be encouraged in the highs and lows of life.

00.title: Missions
00.content: Bring the hope and healing of Christ to people of every age, location, and language.
